_comment: Remix manifest: each ad = one reference layout + your product photo + your copy, sent to an image model in one shot. SWAP the 'reference' paths for the specific swipe-file ads you want to mimic. Set product_image to a real photo of the pillow. qa.py CANNOT check baked-in text — eyeball every output for compliance and spelling.
